effects.label: Send POST /places/{id}/refresh to the declared Places target.

value.text: Encode the path id, send POST /places/{id}/refresh with no body and a 10-second abort signal, then forward the upstream status and parsed JSON. A caught fetch or JSON parsing error returns 503 PLACES_UNAVAILABLE; completion at Places before an error is unresolved.
value.title: Forward POST /places/{id}/refresh
